reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch deny that 19:24 originates the proverb, treating it as a renewal of the saying already coined in 10:12.

sides.snippet: Who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
sides.verseText: One of the same place answered, Who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?

sides.snippet: lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, \"Is Saul also among the prophets?\"
sides.verseText: He also stripped off his clothes, and he also prophesied before Samuel, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, \"Is Saul also among the prophets?\"
